#include <iostream>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

    LL x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    LL best_num = 1LL << 32;
    LL best_den = 1LL << 32;
    LL best_err = 1LL << 32;

    LL b = 1;
    while (b <= n) {
        LL a = max(x * b / y - 10, 0LL);
        LL j = 0;
        while (j < 20) {
            LL num = a + j;
            LL err = abs(x * b - num * y);
            if (best_err * b > err * best_den) {
                best_err = err;
                best_num = num;
                best_den = b;
            } else if (best_err * b == err * best_den) {
                if (best_den > b || (best_den == b && best_num > num)) {
                    best_err = err;
                    best_num = num;
                    best_den = b;
                }
            }
            ++j;
        }
        ++b;
    }

    cout << best_num << "/" << best_den << endl;
    return 0;
}
